main_text.p: tamen abfq; alteratione fieri nequit. Deinde tametfi quædam sint medicamenta,quę tota substantia noftram immutant corrumpantq; substantiam, non propterea tamen confequitur partis similaris formam perse (salua materia & temperamento) morbo quopiam affici. Nam quicquid morbum perse pati poteft, idem perse agere posse, necesse est:quandoquidem est læsæ, aut im peditæ actionis causa. Sed essentialis forma partis similaris per se nullam actionem edere poteft, quamuis sit ipsius partis natura ac principium motus. Indiget enim primum corporeo instrumento: deinde temperamento, quo bene vel male agat. Igitur forma partis similaris per se cum nul lo poteft conflictari morbo. Præterea omnis morbus est affectus præter naturam corporis organici actu viuentis. Sed forma per se non est corpus, sed corporis pars essentialis ac perfectio. Igitur partis similaris forma nullum morbum per se pati poteft.

page.notes: Reading is partly uncertain at several line ends. The scan is faint at "substantiam" and "essentialis"; "substantia" and "substantiam" were read from the line and are marked where doubtful in the lines. The word "substantiam" in "corrumpantq; substantiam" was read from the scan as "fubftantiam" and is printed in Latin spelling. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Several words near the centre of the page are blurred; the lines of the centred block "bum per se pati / poteft." are copied as printed, with the broken word "morbum" split across lines as printed.
